# Reviewed behavior declarations

This supplementary catalogue covers explicitly reviewed behaviors that need no separate setting or action. It is not an exhaustive product inventory or a native application delivery certificate. A declared behavior may have a documented limitation. Application Undo and automatic Backspace restoration are distinct.

Edit `_shared/settings/data/features/behaviors.json` after reviewing the named owners, then run `npm run codegen:feature-inventory`. Any changed owner file blocks generation until its source receipt is explicitly reviewed; generation never updates review hashes. These conservative whole-file hashes detect source drift, not semantic correctness or an unlisted capability.

| Behavior                            | Windows                                                                                                                                   | macOS                                                                                                                                                 | Linux                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ★ key repeats last keystroke        | Declared: Repeats a mid-word character when no expansion matches and magic-key repeat is enabled.                                         | Declared: Repeats a mid-word character when no expansion matches and magic-key repeat is enabled.                                                     | Declared: Repeats a mid-word character when no expansion matches and magic-key repeat is enabled.                                                     |
| Restore an expansion with Backspace | Declared: An immediate unmodified Backspace can restore an eligible plain-text expansion; native text-field behavior remains unqualified. | Declared: An immediate unmodified Backspace can restore an eligible plain-text expansion; native text-field behavior remains unqualified.             | Declared: An immediate unmodified Backspace can restore an eligible plain-text expansion; native text-field behavior remains unqualified.             |
| Magic-key repeat activation window  | Not declared: No separate activation window for fallback repetition; idle word reset is independent.                                      | Declared: Uses the effective magic-key activation window, including modifier timing rules; zero disables this window. Idle word reset is independent. | Declared: Uses the effective magic-key activation window, including modifier timing rules; zero disables this window. Idle word reset is independent. |
| Dead-key composition                | Declared: Builtin dead-key maps and registry layout emulation.                                                                            | Declared: The native keyboard layout owns composition; physical payload grouping is unverified.                                                       | Declared: Native XKB/Compose with independent text capture; consumed continuations can diverge.                                                       |
| Unmapped dead-key continuation      | Declared: An unmapped continuation emits the accent terminator followed by the current character.                                         | Declared: Fallback belongs to the native layout; its physical payload and application output are unverified.                                          | Declared: Converted Compose tables type the accent, then the current character, as macOS does.                                                        |
| Pending dead-key lifetime           | Declared: Builtin maps wait up to 2 seconds; registry dead-key state has no timeout. Expiry and pause cancel a pending dead key.          | Declared: The native OS owns pending composition; capture and reset rules are separate from a shared driver timeout.                                  | Declared: The native OS owns pending composition; capture and reset rules are separate from a shared driver timeout.                                  |
| Layout to emulate                   | Declared: Types the chosen .keylayout over the system layout; the three drivers replay one keystroke corpus.                              | Declared: Types the chosen .keylayout over the system layout; the three drivers replay one keystroke corpus.                                          | Declared: Types the chosen .keylayout over the system layout; the three drivers replay one keystroke corpus.                                          |
